author: DayDreamYT
body:
Name: DayDreamYT
Reason for Being Banned: Back in November 23, 2014 I decided to cheat and use mods in Nebula, this was nearly a year ago. I own up and admit to have been using mods, and I haven't used any mods since. 
Why I should be unbanned: I have had a year of being banned and I realize what I did was wrong and I haven't used mods since that day. Using a modded client is stupid and I'm sincerely sorry to the players and staff for my stupid actions, I promise to not use mods again and I have recently gotten into Minecraft. The day I got banned was last since I played MC. I ask for your sympathy to unban me. It has been a year and I'm sorry and will NEVER do it again. I haven't tried to ban evade because as I said I haven't played since that day. I'm dearly sorry. Please unban me. <3 :)
